notes: The CP criterion is a single holistic requirement for a product flow chart demonstrating movement and integrity. The validated RuleSetRelation groups G1 (SPECIALIZES) and G2 (SUPPORTS_SAME_CRITERION) indicate that the tracing provisions (4-7B, 4-7B(a), 4-7B(b)) and the integrity provision (4-8) jointly support one benchmark proposition without independent cumulative branches. Therefore, a single atom A1 is used with multiple legal bases. No ALL/ANY structure is justified because the CP does not explicitly require separate sub-requirements and the legal provisions are not cumulative but complementary aspects of the same flow chart requirement.
